inputEncoding: Strings are exact JSON-escaped UTF-16 text; {repeat,count} expands with String.repeat; {nonString} intentionally violates the public input boundary.
observationNormalization: Timestamps removed; revisions are offsets from each newly constructed extractor; Maps preserve insertion order as key/value lists and Sets preserve iteration order as lists.
status: Executed source fixtures only. No replacement implementation exists; these observations are future decoder conformance requirements, not a proof of TypeScript/source refinement.

fixtures.contract: Complete CRLF lines remove the delimiter; quoted JSON escapes decode before selected output.
Partial field keys remain buffered until a complete line or flush.
Invalid double-quoted JSON strips matching quotes and preserves the enclosed raw escape.
Bracket and brace suffixes are excluded from the base field identity.
Continuation strips two spaces or one tab; unselected multiline contents remain tracked but unstreamed.
Indented text cannot open a top-level field.
Repeated headers append one newline, while start/done callbacks fire once per field.
Level two retains selected content until flush.
Bare CR is not a delimiter, and the header regex's dot does not match it, so an inline candidate containing CR is ignored.
Bare CR is retained in continuation content after an already-open field.
An empty quoted selected value validates without producing a nonempty chunk.
An unmatched leading quote stays literal; this extractor is not a whole-document validator.
Matching single quotes strip once after trimming; their interior escapes remain literal.
Numeric-first and space-containing keys do not satisfy the top-level header grammar.

fixtures.contract: Reset clears content and callback identities, resets configured schema states, and retains unknown field-status entries.
Line extractor retry retains validated values and stops accepting new chunks until reset.
An aborted push emits one error and transitions to failed without consuming input.
A chunk longer than 1,048,576 UTF-16 units throws CHUNK_TOO_LARGE before changing retained input.
Non-string chunks throw TypeError while streaming.

fixtures.contract: Split field-key and value tokens retain their exact pending suffix and decode selected escapes.
An unsupported escape is retained literally in selected string output.
Escaped high and low surrogates join across chunks before well-formed output.
Raw high and low surrogates join across pushes.
Lone surrogate code units become replacement characters at visible output.
Reasoning tags match case-insensitively across chunk boundaries and their bodies are withheld.
An unfinished potential opening tag outside reasoning flushes as visible text.
An unclosed recognized reasoning tag retains its body without exposing it at flush.
Parts output ends at the first disallowed kind, preserving prior visible text and suppressing later parts.
Value before kind is an undecidable parts shape and holds the attempt.
Malformed quoted kind is refused as an unstreamable parts shape.
Ordered accepted parts accumulate in one field without introducing separators.
Gate receives decoded complete preceding top-level members once, then authorizes one value.
False gate result holds without selected output.
Gate exception is treated as denial, with no visible output.
A nested selected key cannot yield a complete top-level prefix and never invokes the gate.
Malformed preceding JSON holds before invoking the gate.
After a gated selected value ends, later selected values remain withheld.
More than 65,536 UTF-16 units before gate decision holds and clears the retained prefix.
Raw prose invokes the gate with null and streams through if allowed.
Raw prose is withheld when the null-prefix gate denies.
A partial key, colon and string opener are retained across distinct pushes.
Non-selected control fields remain outside visible selected chunks.
Ordered parsing consumes declared literal glue and a selected free string.
Final flush retains a truncated selected string's visible prefix.
Final flush emits the completed visible prefix and discards the incomplete trailing Unicode escape while closing the truncated string.
Skeleton retry emits retry metadata and resets the stream state immediately.
Abort changes state to failed, retains the previous visible prefix, and emits no following text.
A chunk longer than 1,048,576 UTF-16 units throws before parsing.
Non-string chunks throw TypeError while streaming.
